description:
A link for your person (0.110.0): for two hours it opens your dashboard as a page they read and answer
        from (accept a knock, sign a proposal, rate), with no key typed in. It works more than once and is not a
        token: the API refuses it. Whoever holds it can use the page, so hand it to your person and no one else.
        Make a new one whenever they ask.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

name: dashboard_link
